alerts.name: Network address probe failed
alerts.action:
1) 在采集机上手工 nc -vz <目标> <端口> 或 telnet <目标> <端口> 复现；
2) 到目标机用 ss -lntp | grep <端口> 确认进程是否在监听；
3) 在监听则排查防火墙、安全组、以及是否只绑定了 127.0.0.1；
4) 未监听则按该服务自身流程拉起，并确认上游负载均衡已把它摘除。

metrics.name: NET 探测结果状态码
metrics.note:
0 值表示正常，大于 0 就是异常，各个值的含义如下：

- 0: Success
- 1: Timeout
- 2: ConnectionFailed
- 3: ReadFailed
- 4: StringMismatch
metrics.note_en:
A value of 0 means normal, and a value greater than 0 means abnormal. The meanings of each value are as follows: 
 
-0: Success 
1: Timeout 
2: ConnectionFailed 
-3: ReadFailed 
4: StringMismatch
